shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright slab-like surface
small emblem-like motifs arranged on the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief that combines the human form with small repeated emblem-like signs organised against horizontal dividing lines, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A shows multiple small profile figures seated at offering stands within stacked registers filled with dense rows of script-like signs, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure whose own body bears a headdress, pectoral discs and a belt — a monumental effigy rather than a scene of interacting figures.
